guidance.summary: Targeting total revenue of almost INR 56,000 crore in FY27 excluding Vivo
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: Next year, we are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.

guidance.summary: Expecting revenue growth of 15% to 17% in FY27 excluding Vivo
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We fe el that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.

guidance.summary: Expecting IT products revenue to exceed INR 4,000 crore in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: And we feel that our revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting camera module revenue of almost INR 2,500 crore in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.

guidance.summary: Targeting telecom and networking revenue of INR 7,500 to 8,000 crore
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.

guidance.summary: Targeting lighting segment revenue of almost INR 1,700 crore in FY27
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores.

guidance.summary: Targeting display business revenue of INR 5,500 to 6,000 crore at scale
guidance.speaker: Atul Lall
guidance.quote: In the final picture of this business, the revenue target, once we start achieving 80% to 90% of the capacity utilization, the revenue generation is going to be almost INR5,500 crores to INR6,000 crores with a double -digit margin.
